notes: P2: #14 is labeled Merian on Commons but carries an Italian dedication (to a theologian of Cardinal Orsini) and is dated only ‘17th century’; skipped as doubtful. #15 is a cropped, glare-lit detail of Geffels’s 1686 siege painting with no recognizable landmarks; skipped. #18 (Belvedere, dated 1820) shows the Chain Bridge towers (built 1839–49), so its date is wrong; skipped. #22 shows the finished Franz Joseph Bridge (opened 1896), so dated late 1890s rather than the default 1895. #1 is the Nuremberg Chronicle’s distinct Buda view, not a reused stock block.
